source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「飛行機」(1)機体の特徴

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行機の失速時は舵の操作が効かなくなり、操縦性が大きく低下する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 失速は揚力だけの変化で操縦舵の有効性には影響しない。
evidence.reasoning_path: stall state -> reduced control effectiveness -> hazard recognition

collision.note: MEDIUM。Q067は迎角過大→剥離→揚力減/抗力増を問う。本問は失速後のcontrol effectivenessをanswer-defining propositionとする。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 explicitly says flight-control surfaces cease to be effective in stall. Q067 tests the cause/effects of excessive angle of attack, not post-stall controllability.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
